title: Automated Sample Preparation for GNA Octea
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Add Magnetic Beads to Samples
steps.instruction: Using the Single‑Channel Pipette, mix the Magnetic Beads, aspirate 10 µL, add RS1 if the option is selected, and dispense into each of the 8 samples using the same tip for all transfers.

substeps.instruction: Mix Magnetic Beads before aspiration.
Aspirate 10 µL of Magnetic Beads.
If RS1 is selected, add RS1 to the aspirate.
Dispense the 10 µL into each of the 8 sample wells using the same tip.

steps.title: Add HB1 to Samples
steps.instruction: For each sample, pick up a tip with the Single‑Channel Pipette, transfer a total of 680 µL HB1 (delivered as four 170 µL aliquots), mix the sample 10 times, perform a touch‑tip, and discard the tip in waste.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a fresh tip.
Aspirate 170 µL HB1 and dispense into the sample; repeat three more times for a total of 680 µL.
Mix the sample by aspirating/dispensing 10 times.
Touch the tip to the side of the well to remove droplets.
Drop the tip into the waste container.

steps.title: Heat to 80 °C and Incubate
steps.instruction: Set the Temperature Module to 80 °C and hold for 3 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Set Temperature Module to 80 °C.
Delay for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Cool to 56 °C and Mix
steps.instruction: Set the Temperature Module to 56 °C; while the module cools, use the Single‑Channel Pipette to mix each sample.

substeps.instruction: Set Temperature Module to 56 °C.
During the cooling period, mix each sample with the Single‑Channel Pipette.

steps.title: Incubate at 56 °C then Transfer Samples
steps.instruction: After a 3‑minute incubation at 56 °C, transfer the samples to the Deepwell Plate positioned on the Magnetic Module using the Single‑Channel Pipette.

substeps.instruction: Incubate samples at 56 °C for 3 minutes.
Using the Single‑Channel Pipette, transfer each sample to the corresponding well of the Deepwell Plate on the Magnetic Module.

steps.title: Engage Magnet and Collect Supernatant (160 µL)
steps.instruction: Engage the Magnetic Module, wait 2 minutes, then using the Multi‑Channel Pipette transfer 160 µL of supernatant (5 ×) from each well to well A1 of the 12‑Well Reservoir.

substeps.instruction: Engage the Magnetic Module.
Delay for 2 minutes.
With the Multi‑Channel Pipette, aspirate 160 µL of supernatant (repeat 5 times if required) and dispense into well A1 of the 12‑Well Reservoir.

steps.title: Add WB1 and Mix
steps.instruction: Using the Multi‑Channel Pipette with fresh tips, dispense 200 µL of WB1 into each well and mix the contents 12 times.

substeps.instruction: Pick up new tips for each channel.
Transfer 200 µL WB1 to each well.
Mix each well by aspirating/dispensing 12 times.

steps.title: Engage Magnet and Collect Supernatant (200 µL)
steps.instruction: Engage the Magnetic Module again, wait 2 minutes, then transfer 200 µL of supernatant from each well to well A1 of the 12‑Well Reservoir using the Multi‑Channel Pipette.

substeps.instruction: Engage the Magnetic Module.
Delay for 2 minutes.
Aspirate 200 µL supernatant from each well with the Multi‑Channel Pipette and dispense into well A1 of the 12‑Well Reservoir.

steps.title: Add PCA to Sample Wells
steps.instruction: If selected, reconstitute PCA first; then, using a single tip on the Single‑Channel Pipette, dispense 40 µL of PCA into each Deepwell sample well.

substeps.instruction: If the protocol option is set, reconstitute the PCA before use.
Pick up a single tip.
Transfer 40 µL PCA to each sample well in the Deepwell Plate.

steps.title: Mix and Transfer to GNA Octea
steps.instruction: For each sample, pick up a new tip, mix the sample, and transfer 40 µL into the corresponding GNA Octea well.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a fresh tip for the sample.
Mix the sample (e.g., by aspirating/dispensing).
Transfer 40 µL of the mixed sample to the designated GNA Octea well.
